description: This Java class defines a REST controller for system documentation endpoints, including an API info endpoint with real-time connection notes. It includes annotations for API documentation and request mapping, and contains comments related to requirement traceability.

classes.name: SystemDocsController
classes.description: A REST controller providing system information and documentation endpoints, including details about WebSocket usage and application info.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/info, returning application information and real-time connection notes.
